priorityList: Use Racial abilities, Potions, and Trinkets when Coordinated Assault (Takedown) is active or ready.
Use Kill Command if you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear and a Pack Leader Howl buff (Wyvern, Boar, or Bear) is active.
Use Wildfire Bomb if Wyvern's Cry is active and about to expire to extend Fury of the Wyvern.
Use Kill Command if Coordinated Assault (Takedown) is about to come off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Use Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if your Raptor Swipe (Mongoose Fury) buff is missing and Coordinated Assault is nearly ready.
Use Explosive Shot (Boomstick) if Tip of the Spear is active.
Use Coordinated Assault (Takedown) if you have at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear (or 0 stacks if talented into Twin Fangs).
Use Wildfire Bomb if Tip of the Spear is active and Coordinated Assault is not currently running.
Use Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if Tip of the Spear is active or the Raptor Swipe buff is missing.
Use Kill Command as your primary generator when Coordinated Assault (Takedown) is on cooldown.
Use Wildfire Bomb if no other high-priority actions are available.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are forced out of melee range (6+ yards) of your target.
